rows.14:16f1c:
Then he shoved me into a stall, came in after me, and locked the door.
(Ugh, gross!)
"We don't need a stall, do we? There's nobody in the restroom anyway."
I wanted to get out of this situation.
"It'll only take a sec~"
He sidled up close to me.
"After that, I asked Arai about it.
The next victim... turns out it's me."
He said it without his smile ever slipping.
(He knows he's the sacrifice, so how can he keep smiling?)
It was eerie.
"But Arai told me there's one way, just one, to be saved.
Since you're my best friend, I'd been thinking I wouldn't do it."{p}
rows.14:17134:
Hosoda looked a little angry as he said it.
"But, y'know, {a}, you don't seem to feel that way."
With that, he dropped his eyes toward the floor.
I followed Hosoda's gaze.
(Hm...?)
Something moved behind Hosoda's legs.
As I stared, a doll's face peeked out.{p}
rows.14:17724:
"Where are you looking, {a}?"
Shindo turned around, as if wondering what {f:I|I} was looking at.
But Arai had already vanished, so all he could do was look this way and that.
"What's the matter, {a}!"
"Just now, Arai walked right behind you and went around that corner."{p}
rows.14:182b0:
...Shindo and {f:I|I} looked at each other.
Considering everything that had happened, we couldn't flatly write off Arai's story from yesterday as just a joke.
{f:But|But} yesterday, {f:I|I} was supposed to be the only one who could see it{f:|, though}...
"Shindo, what do we do..."
"Don't ask me..."
Shindo was at a loss too.
"I'm going to die..."
Fukuzawa murmured.{p}
rows.14:18510:
When I happened to look up, I saw Arai at one of the old school building's windows.
"Arai..."
"Huh, Arai?"
Shindo said it as he followed {f:my|my} gaze.
"Let's go!"
With that shout, he went into the old school building.
I helped Fukuzawa to her feet, and {f:we|we} went after him.{p}
rows.14:1899c:
"But since you've gone to the trouble of coming,
why don't we play a game here?"
For the first time, Arai looked over at Shindo and {f:me|me}.
"Take a majority vote among yourselves and choose one person.
And let's make that one the final sacrifice."{p}
rows.14:18c8c:
{f:I|I} hesitated.
What {f:I|I} want to know is probably written in here.
But I also have a nasty feeling that if I look at it, something terrible will happen.
...{f:My|My} bad feelings usually come true.
Lately I've felt that more than ever.
{f:I|I} picked up the diary.
The sepia-tinged diary gave off a faintly musty smell.{p}
rows.14:1a0dc:
I-It's the doll{f:|}......
The doll's eyes glowed eerily.
{f:I|I} backed away.
I {f:slammed|bumped} into something and turned back around.{p}
